query_support: Official label-source rows, but all255country predictions sealed before label-file parsing or source selection
forecast_rule: At year tau use only observed edge years strictly less than tau; predict all255sources, then release complete edges at tau. No within-year row-order information.
initialization: Initialize unmodified native baseline classes with fully observed1986edge vectors before1987 forecast; this is a disclosed scheduler/init adaptation versus author examples.

metric.name: NDCG@10
metric.aggregation: Mean queried nations within each target year, then equal mean target years per split
metric.uncertainty: Sample SD across target years, descriptive serially dependent periods, not optimizer seeds

framework_requirement: Competitor algorithms from exact author code. This stage trains no neural model.
prospective_comparison_use: Fixed causal diagnostic baselines for a later registered Torch/PyG ordered-graph model, no standalone novelty/leaderboard claim
